title: Graftline Assistants
text:
Graftline Assistants

notes:
Founder-led deal. Elena Torres (founder/CTO) building a lightweight in-app support assistant for two-sided marketplace. Wants hosted, self-serve first; may consider Dedicated later if usage spikes. Key themes from call: 
- 'We need predictable bills — show me examples for 50k, 200k and 1M tokens.' 
- Concerned about total cost vs OpenAI and Anthropic; wants to see effective per-conversation cost with Redwood's batching/caching knobs.
- Latency target: interactive chat under ~200-300ms for short prompts; acceptable to route high-cost/long-context generation to cheaper model variants.
- Data handling: PII will appear in prompts (user emails/order ids) — needs audit logs and SOC2 compliance. Retention controls desired but not strict residency.
- Founder prefers self-serve sign-up; will upgrade to monthly commit if unit economics look good.
- Quote from call: 'We love the idea of model fallbacks — four models is fine as long as switching is automatic.'
- Technical note: currently using serverless backend (Vercel) + PostgreSQL, expects <50 RPS average but spikes during promotions.
- Asks: simple pricing worksheet, examples of token cost after caching, and a short README for migrating from OpenAI API calls to Redwood SDK.


reason_for_redwood:
Looking for cost controls (batching, caching, model routing) and a dev-friendly hosted API with clear per-token billing. Interested in vendor that can explain unit economics simply to a small founding team.

integration_notes:
Prototype using standard completion/chat endpoint. Want sample Node + Python quickstart that mirrors existing OpenAI call shapes. Elastic keys + per-key quotas requested.

pricing_notes:
High priority: create a short two-column comparison (OpenAI vs Redwood hosted) showing token price, expected token-per-conversation, and a small table with cost for 10k/100k/1M tokens. Include examples with caching and reduced model size fallback. Offer pointer to free credit extension if needed.

timeline:
2026-02-25 - Inbound signup: trial API key created, 1000 free-credit use allocated
2026-03-02 - Discovery call (founder Elena Torres) - 30m, Fireflies transcript attached
2026-03-05 - Quick demo of SDK + chat endpoint by AE (Maya). Shared sample integration snippets
2026-03-09 - Follow-up email: Elena asked for side-by-side cost per 1M tokens vs OpenAI + examples
2026-03-12 - Internal SE check: suggested smaller model fallback and KV caching to reduce cost

blockers:
pricing clarity vs OpenAI/Anthropic
need simple cost examples for founders
latency SLA expectations

next_step:
Send hosted API pricing sheet + token-cost examples; follow-up call with founder week of 2026-03-22

follow_up_tasks:
Prepare pricing comparison doc
SE to draft simple caching recommendation (prefix cache + per-user KV TTL)
Share migration snippet for OpenAI->Redwood SDK

owner_notes:
AE to push a one-pager price comparison and offer live walkthrough next week. Keep it lightweight — founder prefers quick concrete examples over long slides. Champion: Maya. SE support: Jasper.
